$ ilspycmd -ds AsyncAwait=false bin/Release/net11.0/readloop.dll
    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.Async)]
    static Task<int> ServeAsync(TcpClient tcpClient)
    {
      //IL_0053: Expected Obj, but got I4
      StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(tcpClient.GetStream());
      int num = 0;
      Console.WriteLine(Here.Where() + "  waiting for a line");
      while (true)
      {
        string text = AsyncHelpers.Await(streamReader.ReadLineAsync());
        if (text == null)
        {
          break;
        }
        num++;
        Console.WriteLine(Here.Where() + "  got \"" + text + "\"");
      }
      return (Task<int>)num;
    }
